text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower is finally making her 
Twinkle Series debut.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sure it'll be all right.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I worked really hard in training too. So 
everything will be fine... right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. ...Shall we head to 
the racetrack, then?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, so among the girls debuting today, 
there's this one named Nishino Flower, 
right?”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, about my story—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, she skipped a grade to get in, right? 
That's amazing, but it also means she's 
still just a kid. Is she gonna be okay?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh? If it's Tracen Academy, they give 
plenty of support, don't they?"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Still, the Trainer seems kinda green~. I 
wonder if they're actually able to give 
proper guidance.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower has been quiet for a while 
now. Hearing what others thought of her 
must have made her anxious. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: If it's you, you'll be just fine!
If it's you, you'll be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, today has been 'all right' all day 
long, hasn't it?
choice_data_list: I'm sorry, that's all I can really say...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, that's not it! I'm just so 
happy...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, everything will be fine. I believe 
in your words, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm heading off!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Still, the Trainer seems kinda green~. I 
wonder if they're actually able to give 
proper guidance.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(It's true that Trainer is a rookie. But 
they guided me with all their heart and 
brought me all the way here.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(If I can give it my all today. If 
everything turns out "alright"...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if the people watching... will 
acknowledge my Trainer, too.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "...Alright. Do your best, Flower!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make sure everyone knows how 
hard Trainer is working!
